name: lib/net-clients
description: Network clients and servers that are programs, not protocol: FTP, SSH, Telnet, Samba, mail, TFTP, the chat demos, and the X/YMODEM transfers -- plus TLS and the three HTTP stacks.
residual: Split out of std/net on 2026-08-27 by the Rust border (docs/STDLIB.md): the standard library keeps what packages talk to each other through, and these are leaves ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/; `headless` false keeps them out of the SDK payload.
